title: OL-20261127-6: Q-ASHBY-ledger: Step trials, commits and rollbacks have no table, so interference() and failureRecall() cannot read live data
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** ASHBY-KERNEL-1 merged (PR 2629); work record issue 2620
**Done check:** cmd:grep -q step_trials seed/worker/src/ashby.js
**Closing probe:** `node --test seed/worker/test/ashby.test.js seed/worker/test/organization.test.js` passes with a test that exercises it, and grep -q step_trials seed/worker/src/ashby.js exits 0
**Prediction:** ashby_concepts_implemented >= 18 within 336 h
**Out of scope:** copying any text or image from ashby.info; blind random search
**Status:** open

Problem: Step trials, commits and rollbacks have no table, so interference() and failureRecall() cannot read live data. Build: a migration adding step_trials(partition, candidate, start_tick, outcome) and a tick read that calls interference and evoke.
